- [ChatDictationButton — States](templates/ChatDictationDictationStates.md) (`ChatDictationDictationStates`): Dictation button in idle, listening, and speaking states side by side. Shows the three visual phases of a voice input interaction.
- [ChatLayout](templates/ChatLayoutShowcase.md) (`ChatLayoutShowcase`): 
- [ChatLayout — Panel View](templates/ChatLayoutPanelChat.md) (`ChatLayoutPanelChat`): Narrow sidebar chat in a constrained container that triggers compact density. Use for side panels, drawers, or embedded chat widgets where horizontal space is limited.
- [ChatLayoutScrollButton](templates/ChatLayoutScrollButtonStates.md) (`ChatLayoutScrollButtonStates`): Scroll button in hidden, visible, and expanded (with label) states. The button fades in when the user scrolls up and expands when new messages arrive.
- [ChatLayoutScrollButton — Labels](templates/ChatLayoutScrollButtonLabels.md) (`ChatLayoutScrollButtonLabels`): Scroll button with different labels for context-specific notifications like new messages, unread replies, or a generic scroll prompt.
- [ChatMessage](templates/ChatMessageShowcase.md) (`ChatMessageShowcase`): A user multi-bubble group with delivery status and an assistant ghost response with avatar, name, timestamp, and model info.
- [ChatMessage — Avatar & Name](templates/ChatMessageAvatarName.md) (`ChatMessageAvatarName`): Messages with avatars and sender names. Place the name on the bubble when using bubbles, or on the message wrapper for raw content.
- [ChatMessage — Ghost](templates/ChatMessageGhost.md) (`ChatMessageGhost`): Ghost variant for messages without visible bubble boundaries. Keeps padding for alignment but renders a transparent background, useful for AI-style responses.
- [ChatMessage — Multi-Bubble](templates/ChatMessageMultiBubble.md) (`ChatMessageMultiBubble`): Grouped bubbles using the group prop for corner radius reduction. Use first, middle, and last to visually connect related bubbles from the same sender.
- [ChatMessageBubble](templates/ChatMessageBubbleShowcase.md) (`ChatMessageBubbleShowcase`): Grouped user bubbles with filled styling and a ghost-variant agent response, with timestamps and delivery status.
- [ChatMessageBubble — Custom Content](templates/ChatMessageBubbleCustomContent.md) (`ChatMessageBubbleCustomContent`): Custom in-message content aligned to the bubble text column. An artifact card is wrapped in a ghost bubble with width="100%", so its left edge matches the bubble text and it spans the full message column instead of the default bubble width cap; the timestamp rides the bubble metadata slot.
- [ChatMessageBubble — Density](templates/ChatMessageBubbleDensity.md) (`ChatMessageBubbleDensity`): Compact, balanced, and spacious density modes side by side. Density controls bubble padding, corner radius, and spacing between grouped bubbles.
- [ChatMessageBubble — Grouping](templates/ChatMessageBubbleGrouping.md) (`ChatMessageBubbleGrouping`): Multi-bubble messages using first, middle, and last group positions. Grouped bubbles tighten corner radius on the sender side for a continuous visual flow.
- [ChatMessageBubble — Metadata](templates/ChatMessageBubbleMetadata.md) (`ChatMessageBubbleMetadata`): Bubbles with name and metadata slots aligned to bubble padding. Put name on the first bubble and metadata on the last bubble in a message.
- [ChatMessageBubble — Variants](templates/ChatMessageBubbleVariants.md) (`ChatMessageBubbleVariants`): Filled and ghost bubble variants for both user and assistant senders. Use filled for standard messages and ghost when content needs alignment without a visual boundary.
- [ChatMessageList](templates/ChatMessageListShowcase.md) (`ChatMessageListShowcase`): Basic AI chat conversation with user and assistant messages. The simplest way to render a message list with alternating sender bubbles, metadata, and a date divider.
- [ChatMessageList — Density](templates/ChatMessageListDensity.md) (`ChatMessageListDensity`): Side-by-side comparison of compact, balanced, and spacious densities. Use compact in sidebars or panels, balanced for most full-page chat, and spacious for long-form reading. Use gap when row spacing needs to differ from density.
- [ChatMessageList — Full Featured](templates/ChatMessageListFullFeatured.md) (`ChatMessageListFullFeatured`): Conversation showcasing system messages, multi-bubble grouping, markdown, code blocks, and metadata. Combines date dividers, ghost bubbles, grouped messages, and rich content in a single example.
- [ChatMessageMetadata](templates/ChatMessageMetadataShowcase.md) (`ChatMessageMetadataShowcase`): Three-message conversation showcasing error status with retry, delivery status, and full footer actions with model label.
- [ChatMessageMetadata — Footer Actions](templates/ChatMessageMetadataFooter.md) (`ChatMessageMetadataFooter`): Assistant message with footer actions: copy, retry, thumbs up/down, and model label. Use for AI responses that need feedback or utility controls.
- [ChatMessageMetadata — Status](templates/ChatMessageMetadataStatus.md) (`ChatMessageMetadataStatus`): All 5 delivery statuses (sending, sent, delivered, read, and error), each with a timestamp. Use to show message delivery progress or surface failures.
- [ChatMessageMetadata — Timestamps](templates/ChatMessageMetadataTimestamp.md) (`ChatMessageMetadataTimestamp`): Timestamp-only metadata on user and assistant messages. Supports absolute time and relative formats via Timestamp.
- [ChatSendButton](templates/ChatSendButtonShowcase.md) (`ChatSendButtonShowcase`): Ready, custom icon, and streaming states of the send button.
- [ChatSendButton — Custom Icon](templates/ChatSendButtonCustomIcon.md) (`ChatSendButtonCustomIcon`): Send buttons with custom icons via sendIcon and stopIcon props. Use to match the personality of the chat experience: a paper airplane for messaging, sparkles for AI generation, or a check mark for confirmation flows.
- [ChatSendButton — In Composer](templates/ChatSendButtonInComposer.md) (`ChatSendButtonInComposer`): Send button inside ChatComposer, where it reads state from context automatically. No wiring needed; the button enables when the input has content.
- [ChatSendButton — States](templates/ChatSendButtonStates.md) (`ChatSendButtonStates`): Disabled, ready, and streaming states at both sizes. The button automatically toggles between send (primary) and stop (secondary) based on streaming state.
- [ChatSystemMessage](templates/ChatSystemMessageShowcase.md) (`ChatSystemMessageShowcase`): System messages for date dividers, status updates, and informational notices. Shows both default and divider variants in a realistic conversation flow.
- [ChatSystemMessage — Icon](templates/ChatSystemMessageWithIcon.md) (`ChatSystemMessageWithIcon`): System messages with a leading icon that reinforces the message type. Use icons to help users scan and identify message categories at a glance.
- [ChatSystemMessage — Status Updates](templates/ChatSystemMessageStatusUpdates.md) (`ChatSystemMessageStatusUpdates`): Realistic status messages in a conversation flow showing membership changes, timestamps, and resolution notices.
- [ChatSystemMessage — Variants](templates/ChatSystemMessageVariants.md) (`ChatSystemMessageVariants`): Default and divider variants side by side. Use default for inline status updates and divider for date separators or section breaks.
- [ChatTokenizedText](templates/ChatTokenizedTextShowcase.md) (`ChatTokenizedTextShowcase`): 
- [ChatTokenizedText — Basic](templates/ChatTokenizedTextBasic.md) (`ChatTokenizedTextBasic`): A message with @mention tokens. Each matching pattern is replaced with its display name badge.
- [ChatTokenizedText — Colors](templates/ChatTokenizedTextColors.md) (`ChatTokenizedTextColors`): Tokens with different color variants to distinguish mentions, bugs, and features. Use variant colors to create a visual taxonomy: blue for people, red for bugs, green for features.
- [ChatToolCalls](templates/ChatToolCallsShowcase.md) (`ChatToolCallsShowcase`): 
- [ChatToolCalls — Expandable](templates/ChatToolCallsInteractiveToolCalls.md) (`ChatToolCallsInteractiveToolCalls`): Tool calls with expandable result details showing diffs and command output in code blocks. Click a row to reveal its result.
- [ChatToolCalls — Simple](templates/ChatToolCallsToolCallsWithNodes.md) (`ChatToolCallsToolCallsWithNodes`): A single inline tool call above a collapsible multi-call group with diff stats. Shows both layouts side by side.
- [ChatToolCalls — Statuses](templates/ChatToolCallsStatuses.md) (`ChatToolCallsStatuses`): All four status states (pending, running, complete, and error) shown together in a single group.
- [CheckboxInput](templates/CheckboxInputShowcase.md) (`CheckboxInputShowcase`): Interactive checkboxes showing checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states with descriptions.
- [CheckboxInput — Indeterminate](templates/CheckboxInputIndeterminateState.md) (`CheckboxInputIndeterminateState`): A "select all" checkbox that controls a group of options. When only some options are checked, it shows a dash instead of a checkmark. Clicking it checks or unchecks everything.
- [CheckboxInput — States](templates/CheckboxInputBasic.md) (`CheckboxInputBasic`): Checkboxes with labels and descriptions in checked, unchecked, and disabled states. Each checkbox controls a single on/off setting. Add a description to explain what the setting does.
- [CheckboxInput — Status](templates/CheckboxInputStatusVariations.md) (`CheckboxInputStatusVariations`): Checkboxes with error, warning, and success validation messages. Use the status prop to show feedback after form validation: errors block submission, warnings inform, and success confirms.
- [CheckboxList](templates/CheckboxListShowcase.md) (`CheckboxListShowcase`): 
- [CheckboxList — Select All With Indeterminate](templates/CheckboxListSelectAllPattern.md) (`CheckboxListSelectAllPattern`): A "select all" toggle at the top of a checkbox list that switches to an indeterminate dash when only some items are checked, useful for bulk actions like exporting documents or assigning permissions where users often want everything at once.
- [CheckboxList — With End Content](templates/CheckboxListWithEndContent.md) (`CheckboxListWithEndContent`): Badges in the trailing slot show contextual info, like a price or status, next to each option without cluttering the label, so users can compare choices at a glance.
- [CheckboxListItem](templates/CheckboxListItemShowcase.md) (`CheckboxListItemShowcase`): Checkbox list items with labels, descriptions, and different states including disabled.
- [CheckboxListItem — Basic](templates/CheckboxListItemBasic.md) (`CheckboxListItemBasic`): Checkbox items with labels and descriptions inside a controlled CheckboxList. Use for multi-select option groups like notification preferences.
- [Checkout Form](templates/payment-form.md) (`payment-form`): Long sectioned form running beside a summary that stays visible while the fields scroll and recalculates as they change, ending on a terminal confirm of the total. Sections run contact, address, delivery choice, then card details.
- [Checkout Wizard](templates/checkout-wizard.md) (`checkout-wizard`): Multi-step checkout, cart, order, and payment wizard with a running summary that recalculates as answers change. It adapts to its host width, renders the summary first on narrow surfaces, validates every forward path, and completes locally without sending payment.
- [Citation — Inline Text](templates/CitationInlineText.md) (`CitationInlineText`): Citations embedded within a paragraph of text, showing how they flow inline with surrounding content.
- [Citation — Showcase](templates/CitationShowcase.md) (`CitationShowcase`): All citation variants at a glance: label chips and numbered badges, with and without icons and links.
- [Citation — Source List](templates/CitationSourceList.md) (`CitationSourceList`): A list of citation sources with icons, as you might show at the end of an AI-generated response or article footer.
- [Classic Gallery](templates/classic-gallery.md) (`classic-gallery`): Uniform grid of equal-ratio media tiles under a centered intro, with filter tabs that narrow the set in place. Regular rhythm, unlike the variable-height masonry variant.
- [ClickableCard](templates/ClickableCardShowcase.md) (`ClickableCardShowcase`): A clickable card that navigates on click. Nested interactive elements work independently.
- [ClickableCard — Elevated](templates/ClickableCardElevated.md) (`ClickableCardElevated`): A clickable card raised with `elevation="med"` so the shadow signals the whole surface is interactive.
- [ClickableCardWithNestedButton](templates/ClickableCardWithNestedButton.md) (`ClickableCardWithNestedButton`): A product card that navigates on click but has an independent "Add to cart" button inside.
- [Code](templates/CodeShowcase.md) (`CodeShowcase`): Inline code snippets inside a sentence showing how Code renders alongside body text.
- [Code — Config](templates/CodeBlockJSONConfig.md) (`CodeBlockJSONConfig`): A JSON configuration file with a title bar and line numbers. The title prop adds a filename label in the header so readers know which file the code belongs to.
- [Code — Content Types](templates/CodeVariousContent.md) (`CodeVariousContent`): Inline code used for variables, terminal commands, CSS properties, file paths, and keyboard shortcuts. Shows how Code adapts to different kinds of technical content.
- [Code — Highlighted](templates/CodeBlockHighlightedLines.md) (`CodeBlockHighlightedLines`): TypeScript code with specific lines highlighted to draw attention to a key section. Use highlightLines to call out new or important code in tutorials and changelogs.
- [Code — Inline](templates/CodeInlineInParagraph.md) (`CodeInlineInParagraph`): Inline code references mixed within a paragraph of body text. Use Code to mark up function names, hooks, or API terms so they stand out from surrounding prose.
- [Code — Scrollable](templates/CodeBlockScrollableBlock.md) (`CodeBlockScrollableBlock`): A long code block with a max height that enables vertical scrolling. Use maxHeight to keep the block from dominating the page when displaying large files.
- [Code — Snippet](templates/CodeBlockBashCommand.md) (`CodeBlockBashCommand`): Short terminal commands with no header: the copy button sits in its own column beside the code, so a one-line command reads as a single row and a long line ends before the button instead of running under it. Use for install instructions or one-liner commands that readers will paste directly.
- [Code — Terminal](templates/CodeBlockTerminal.md) (`CodeBlockTerminal`): A dark terminal-style command block: a bash CodeBlock wrapped in SyntaxTheme with the GitHub Dark preset, copy button on, and no line numbers. Use for shell sessions or CLI output that should read as a terminal even on light pages. Reach for a dark syntax preset instead of hand-rolling a dark box with custom CSS.
- [Code — Text Sizes](templates/CodeAcrossTextSizes.md) (`CodeAcrossTextSizes`): Inline code rendered inside heading, body, supporting, and label text. Code automatically matches the font size of its parent text element.
- [CodeBlock](templates/CodeBlockShowcase.md) (`CodeBlockShowcase`): A syntax-highlighted TypeScript code block with line numbers, a title bar, and a copy button.
- [Collapsible](templates/CollapsibleShowcase.md) (`CollapsibleShowcase`): An accordion group with three collapsible sections in single mode: opening one closes the others.
- [Collapsible — Controlled](templates/CollapsibleControlledAccordion.md) (`CollapsibleControlledAccordion`): Manage the open section from parent state, so something other than a click can move it: a URL parameter, a form jumping to the step that failed validation, or the Previous/Next controls shown here. onChange hands back the whole open value.
- [Collapsible — FAQ](templates/CollapsibleDividedAccordion.md) (`CollapsibleDividedAccordion`): FAQ built with hasDividers: row hairlines and density padding with no custom CSS. Questions set their own type — body at semibold, not the trigger's default 17px large — so a list of questions reads as rows rather than a stack of headings, and question and answer separate on weight and color instead of size.
- [Collapsible — Multiple Mode](templates/CollapsibleMultipleAccordion.md) (`CollapsibleMultipleAccordion`): Several sections open at once, for comparing across them — feature lists, pricing tiers. One Collapsible per Card, so each trigger keeps its own large type: it is the heading of its surface, not a row in a list.
- [Collapsible — Single Mode](templates/CollapsibleSingleAccordion.md) (`CollapsibleSingleAccordion`): Only one section open at a time, so a single body of content competes for attention. Use defaultValue to pre-expand whichever section a first-time reader needs. Each Collapsible owns a Section, so its trigger is that section heading.
- [Collapsible — With Dividers](templates/CollapsibleWithoutCard.md) (`CollapsibleWithoutCard`): A flat list on the page background with hand-placed Dividers, for detail panels and sidebars where cards would add too much weight. Rows, so the triggers step down to body-semibold and a supporting metadata line sits under each answer.
- [Collapsible Table](templates/table-collapsible.md) (`table-collapsible`): Several tables on one page, each in a collapsible card with its own columns — for groups that do not share a schema, where one table would stand full of empty cells. One time range drives them all, and rows expand into a history chart. Accounts, integrations, sections, sort, expand, or collapse.
- [CollapsibleGroup](templates/CollapsibleGroupShowcase.md) (`CollapsibleGroupShowcase`): CollapsibleGroup coordinates its Collapsible children: with type="single", opening one closes the others. No state or handlers in the example — the group owns which value is open and each child only declares its own. One Collapsible per Card, so each trigger keeps its default large type as the heading of its own surface.
- [CollapsibleGroup — Density](templates/CollapsibleGroupAccordion.md) (`CollapsibleGroupAccordion`): density sets the block padding on every row in the group, so a list of sections can be tuned to the surface it sits on without touching the rows. compact for dense surfaces like sidebars and inspectors, balanced (the default) for page content, spacious for a short list that is the main thing on the page. It follows Table's scale and pairs with hasDividers, which turns it on at balanced.
- [CommandPalette](templates/CommandPaletteShowcase.md) (`CommandPaletteShowcase`): Basic command palette with static items and keyboard navigation.
- [CommandPalette — Async Search](templates/CommandPaletteAsyncSearch.md) (`CommandPaletteAsyncSearch`): Server-side search with loading spinner and custom empty states.
- [CommandPalette — Custom Footer](templates/CommandPaletteCustomFooter.md) (`CommandPaletteCustomFooter`): Command palette with a custom footer tip message.
- [CommandPalette — Grouped](templates/CommandPaletteAutoGrouped.md) (`CommandPaletteAutoGrouped`): Command palette with items grouped via auxiliaryData.group.
- [CommandPalette — Picker Mode](templates/CommandPalettePickerMode.md) (`CommandPalettePickerMode`): Single-value picker with persistent selection and check indicator.
- [CommandPalette — Rich Items](templates/CommandPaletteRichItems.md) (`CommandPaletteRichItems`): Custom item rendering with icons, keyboard shortcuts, and keyword search.
- [CommandPaletteEmpty](templates/CommandPaletteEmptyShowcase.md) (`CommandPaletteEmptyShowcase`): Command palette empty state shown when no commands are available.
- [CommandPaletteEmpty — Basic](templates/CommandPaletteEmptyBasic.md) (`CommandPaletteEmptyBasic`): A command palette with no results, showing a custom empty message via emptyBootstrapText. Use to explain why the palette is empty and what the user can do next.
- [CommandPaletteFooter](templates/CommandPaletteFooterShowcase.md) (`CommandPaletteFooterShowcase`): Command palette footer with custom tip content.
- [CommandPaletteFooter — Basic](templates/CommandPaletteFooterBasic.md) (`CommandPaletteFooterBasic`): A command palette footer with no children, rendering the built-in keyboard navigation hints. Use CommandPaletteFooter without content to get the default arrow-key, Enter, and Esc hints below the results list.
- [CommandPaletteGroup](templates/CommandPaletteGroupShowcase.md) (`CommandPaletteGroupShowcase`): Command palette groups in both data-driven (auxiliaryData.group) and composed (CommandPaletteGroup + CommandPaletteItem) forms.
- [CommandPaletteGroup — Basic](templates/CommandPaletteGroupBasic.md) (`CommandPaletteGroupBasic`): Command palette items organized under group headings using the composed CommandPaletteGroup form. Use to separate related commands into labeled sections.
- [CommandPaletteInput](templates/CommandPaletteInputShowcase.md) (`CommandPaletteInputShowcase`): Command palette search input with a custom placeholder and a keyboard shortcut hint in the endContent slot.
- [CommandPaletteInput — With End Content](templates/CommandPaletteInputBasic.md) (`CommandPaletteInputBasic`): Custom placeholder and a keyboard shortcut badge in the trailing slot via endContent.
- [CommandPaletteItem](templates/CommandPaletteItemShowcase.md) (`CommandPaletteItemShowcase`): An inline command palette whose items pair each command label with its keyboard shortcut through renderItem.
- [CommandPaletteItem — Basic](templates/CommandPaletteItemBasic.md) (`CommandPaletteItemBasic`): Selectable command palette items inside a CommandPaletteList, including highlighted and disabled states. Use when composing a palette manually instead of a search source.
- [CommandPaletteList](templates/CommandPaletteListShowcase.md) (`CommandPaletteListShowcase`): Scrollable command palette list with grouped items, including a highlighted item, composed without a full CommandPalette.
- [CommandPaletteList — Item States](templates/CommandPaletteListBasic.md) (`CommandPaletteListBasic`): Flat list showing the highlighted, selected, and disabled item states. Use CommandPaletteGroup to add section headings.
- [Comparison Table](templates/table-comparison.md) (`table-comparison`): Transposed matrix that puts candidates in the columns and criteria in grouped rows, with a pinned label column that survives horizontal scroll, columns you can swap or add, and best-in-row marks you can toggle. Compare, comparison, matrix, spec sheet, feature grid, pricing table, benchmark, frozen column, sticky column, or side-by-side.
- [ComplexSelector](templates/ComplexSelectorShowcase.md) (`ComplexSelectorShowcase`): A two-axis picker: choose a fruit and a ripeness level from one control. ComplexSelector owns the trigger, popover, and focus restore while the custom grid owns its keyboard semantics.
- [ComplexSelector — Deadline Picker](templates/ComplexSelectorDeadlinePicker.md) (`ComplexSelectorDeadlinePicker`): A multi-step deadline field: pick a preset like Today or Next week, or switch to a custom date and time before applying. The popup stays open until the user commits, so the content owns the Apply action.
- [ComplexSelector — Tree Search](templates/ComplexSelectorTreeSearch.md) (`ComplexSelectorTreeSearch`): A destination picker that combines a search field with a TreeList hierarchy. TreeList owns tree keyboard navigation; ComplexSelector owns the trigger, popover, and focus restore. Selecting a folder closes the popup.
- [Contact Form](templates/contact-form.md) (`contact-form`): Flat single-column form mixing control types (text, pill toggles, dropdowns, long free-text) landing on one full-width submit. No steps, no branching, no summary rail.
- [ContextMenu](templates/ContextMenuShowcase.md) (`ContextMenuShowcase`): An adaptive context area that supports long-press on compact touch screens and right-click elsewhere.
- [ContextMenu — Basic](templates/ContextMenuBasic.md) (`ContextMenuBasic`): An adaptive context area: long-press opens a BottomSheet on compact touch screens, while right-click opens a cursor-positioned menu elsewhere.
- [ContextMenu — Bottom Sheet](templates/ContextMenuBottomSheet.md) (`ContextMenuBottomSheet`): A ContextMenu using the explicit BottomSheet presentation. Long-press the target on touch devices or right-click it with a pointer. Keep a visible menu trigger for important mobile actions.
- [ContextMenuItem](templates/ContextMenuItemShowcase.md) (`ContextMenuItemShowcase`): Context menu with custom-rendered items using ContextMenuItem for icons and descriptions.
- [ContextMenuItem — Basic](templates/ContextMenuItemBasic.md) (`ContextMenuItemBasic`): Context menu items with labels and secondary descriptions. Use ContextMenuItem to render custom menu entries with consistent styling.
- [Course Detail](templates/course-detail.md) (`course-detail`): Long-form sales page for a single offering, in two columns — read the pitch, then enroll from a sticky rail. The main column holds a preview poster with a fact row, an about block with skill chips, a module syllabus whose sections collapse module by module, an instructor card, reviews with a scored-aspects panel, and a FAQ; the rail holds the price, a self-paced or cohort start picker, and a weekly-pace slider that computes a finish date. The shape for any offering with a curriculum and a purchase panel — a course, class, masterclass, bootcamp, workshop, or training.
- [createAnimator — Playing cards in plain JavaScript](templates/AnimatorPlayingCardsVanilla.md) (`AnimatorPlayingCardsVanilla`): The playing card from the useAnimator example, built in plain JavaScript with createAnimator and pointer events: it follows a drag, springs back on a gentle release, flies off with momentum on a quick flick, and a button discards it from the keyboard. React only mounts it.
- [createDragToSnapPoints — Playing card in plain JavaScript](templates/DragToSnapPointsCardVanilla.md) (`DragToSnapPointsCardVanilla`): The three-place playing card from the useDragToSnapPoints example, built in plain JavaScript with createDragToSnapPoints: a sideways drag settles it on the nearest place or the next after a flick, buttons settle it from the keyboard, and a live region announces the place. React only mounts it.
- [Data Dashboard](templates/dashboard-comparison.md) (`dashboard-comparison`): Comparison-heavy analytics behind a persistent filter bar: tiles that each carry an inline sparkline and several period-over-period deltas, then segmented breakdowns underneath. Every number is shown against another number.
- [DateInput](templates/DateInputShowcase.md) (`DateInputShowcase`): A date input field with a calendar popover. Type a date or click the calendar icon to pick one.
- [DateInput — Clearable](templates/DateInputClearable.md) (`DateInputClearable`): Date input with a clear button that resets the value. Use when the date field is optional and the user may need to undo their selection.
- [DateInput — Description](templates/DateInputWithDescription.md) (`DateInputWithDescription`): Date input with helper text below the label explaining what the field expects. Use when the purpose of the date is not obvious from the label alone.
- [DateInput — Formats](templates/DateInputFormats.md) (`DateInputFormats`): The format prop reuses Timestamp's format vocabulary to control how the committed value is displayed: date, date_long (default), date_weekday, and system_date, or a function for a fully custom string. Formatting applies only to the committed value, never to text the user is actively typing.
- [DateInput — Min/Max Constraints](templates/DateInputDateRange.md) (`DateInputDateRange`): Date input constrained to a min/max window. Use when only certain dates are valid, like booking availability or a fiscal quarter.
- [DateInput — Validation](templates/DateInputWithValidation.md) (`DateInputWithValidation`): Date input in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface validation issues, caution the user, or confirm a valid selection.
- [DateRangeInput](templates/DateRangeInputShowcase.md) (`DateRangeInputShowcase`): A date range picker with a button trigger and dual-month calendar popover with preset ranges.
- [DateRangeInput — Validation](templates/DateRangeInputWithValidation.md) (`DateRangeInputWithValidation`): Date range input in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface booking conflicts, flag high-demand periods, or confirm an available range.
- [DateRangeInput — With Presets](templates/DateRangeInputWithPresets.md) (`DateRangeInputWithPresets`): Date range picker with quick-select presets for common periods. Use for analytics dashboards, report filters, or any context where users frequently select standard time windows.
- [DateTimeInput](templates/DateTimeInputShowcase.md) (`DateTimeInputShowcase`): A combined date and time picker. Desktop opens a calendar popover with a time input; touch devices open a Date/Time bottom sheet.
- [DateTimeInput — Validation](templates/DateTimeInputWithValidation.md) (`DateTimeInputWithValidation`): DateTimeInput in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface scheduling conflicts, caution the user about edge cases, or confirm a valid datetime.
- [Dialog](templates/DialogShowcase.md) (`DialogShowcase`): Modal dialog with a header, body content, and close button.
- [Dialog — Adaptive presentation](templates/DialogAdaptivePresentation.md) (`DialogAdaptivePresentation`): Opt-in recipe for an AdaptiveDialog wrapper: Dialog remains the default everywhere, while touchPresentation="bottom-sheet" switches only at lg and below when pointer is coarse and hover is unavailable. Includes a deterministic presentation override for tests/unusual environments and notes that BottomSheet purpose controls swipe and scrim dismissal. Usage examples: touchPresentation="dialog" keeps Dialog, "fullscreen" chooses fullscreen Dialog, and "bottom-sheet" chooses BottomSheet only for the touch-oriented range. Keep presentation as the deterministic override. Do not use this by default for AlertDialog or destructive confirmations.
- [Dialog — Confirmation](templates/DialogConfirmationDialog.md) (`DialogConfirmationDialog`): Asks the user to confirm a destructive action before it happens. Use before deleting projects, removing team members, revoking API keys, or any irreversible operation.
- [Dialog — Form](templates/DialogFormDialog.md) (`DialogFormDialog`): Collects user input without navigating away from the page. Uses purpose="form" so clicking the backdrop won't close it. Use for editing profiles, creating items, or updating settings inline.
- [Dialog — Fullscreen](templates/DialogFullscreenDialog.md) (`DialogFullscreenDialog`): Takes over the entire viewport for content that needs maximum space. Use for documentation viewers, rich text editors, multi-step wizards, or media previews where the standard dialog width is too narrow.
- [Dialog — Required](templates/DialogWithSubtitle.md) (`DialogWithSubtitle`): Cannot be dismissed by Escape or backdrop click; the user must explicitly choose an action. Uses purpose="required". Use for ownership transfers, legal acknowledgements, or critical decisions where skipping is not an option.
- [Dialog — Scrollable](templates/DialogScrollingContent.md) (`DialogScrollingContent`): Constrains the dialog height and scrolls the body when content overflows. Use for terms and conditions, license agreements, changelogs, or any long-form content the user needs to review before accepting.
- [Dialog Wizard](templates/form-wizard-dialog.md) (`form-wizard-dialog`): Step through a short flow in a dialog, overlay, or popup launched from the page underneath, which stays where it was. Compact step markers and a pinned action row inside a constrained width, rather than the full page a wizard usually gets. Best for two to four short steps — setup, invite, schedule, onboarding — where losing the context underneath would cost more than the flow is worth.
- [DialogHeader](templates/DialogHeaderShowcase.md) (`DialogHeaderShowcase`): DialogHeader provides a structured header for dialogs with slots for title, subtitle, close button, and optional start or end content.
- [DialogHeader — Basic](templates/DialogHeaderBasic.md) (`DialogHeaderBasic`): A DialogHeader with a title, subtitle, and close button, placed in the header slot of a Dialog Layout. Pass onOpenChange to render the close button.
- [Divider — Full Bleed](templates/DividerFullBleed.md) (`DividerFullBleed`): Divider that extends past container padding to span the full width. Use inside cards or panels when you want a clean edge-to-edge separation, like between an order summary and total.
- [Divider — Variants](templates/DividerShowcase.md) (`DividerShowcase`): Horizontal dividers in subtle and strong variants, plus a labeled divider. A quick visual reference for separator styles.
- [Divider — Variants](templates/DividerVariants.md) (`DividerVariants`): Subtle, labeled, and strong dividers in a single card. Use subtle between related sections, labeled for alternatives like "or", and strong for high-contrast boundaries.
- [Divider — Vertical](templates/DividerVertical.md) (`DividerVertical`): Vertical dividers separating side-by-side metrics. Use between stat cards, toolbar groups, or any horizontal layout where you need a visual boundary between sections.
- [Documentation Catalog](templates/documentation.md) (`documentation`): Reference landing that is pure wayfinding: a banner above a grid of category cards linking into sections, with no article content on the surface itself.
- [Documentation Design](templates/documentation-design.md) (`documentation-design`): Reference article alternating prose with live rendered examples: an interactive preview, a property table, paired do and don't comparisons, and copyable code blocks.
- [Documentation Technical](templates/documentation-technical.md) (`documentation-technical`): Reference article ordered as sequential numbered steps with code at each stage, plus callout cards for prerequisites and onward links. A linear walkthrough rather than a browsable reference.
- [DrawerHeader](templates/DrawerHeaderShowcase.md) (`DrawerHeaderShowcase`): DrawerHeader provides a structured header for drawers with slots for title, subtitle, close button, and optional start or end content.
- [DropdownMenu](templates/DropdownMenuShowcase.md) (`DropdownMenuShowcase`): A button that opens a dropdown menu with action items. The menu starts open for preview.
- [DropdownMenu — Actions](templates/DropdownMenuActions.md) (`DropdownMenuActions`): Action menu with dividers separating safe and destructive operations. Use for row-level actions on items like documents, projects, or records.
- [DropdownMenu — Adaptive presentation](templates/DropdownMenuBottomSheet.md) (`DropdownMenuBottomSheet`): Chooses a bottom sheet for compact touch surfaces and an anchored popover otherwise. The media query is product policy, while DropdownMenu owns both presentations.
- [DropdownMenu — Disabled](templates/DropdownMenuWithDisabledItems.md) (`DropdownMenuWithDisabledItems`): Menu with selectively disabled items based on permissions. Use when some actions require higher privileges, like admin-only operations.
- [DropdownMenu — Icon Trigger](templates/DropdownMenuNoChevron.md) (`DropdownMenuNoChevron`): Overflow menu triggered by an icon-only button with no chevron or label text. Use for row-level actions in tables, cards, or lists where a text button would take too much space.
- [DropdownMenu — Sections](templates/DropdownMenuWithSections.md) (`DropdownMenuWithSections`): Menu items organized into titled sections for easy scanning. Use when you have 6+ actions that fall into distinct categories, like Create vs Manage.
- [DropdownMenu — Submenu](templates/DropdownMenuWithSubmenu.md) (`DropdownMenuWithSubmenu`): Action menu with a nested submenu. Hover or Right arrow opens the flyout; Left arrow / Escape closes it. Use to group related destinations or secondary actions without crowding the top level.
- [DropdownMenuGroup](templates/DropdownMenuGroupShowcase.md) (`DropdownMenuGroupShowcase`): A compound-mode menu whose rows are titled in groups. Each DropdownMenuGroup renders a role="group" named by its heading; arrow keys and typeahead skip the heading.
- [DropdownMenuGroup — Selectable rows](templates/DropdownMenuGroupWithSelectable.md) (`DropdownMenuGroupWithSelectable`): Titled groups around a radio group and checkbox rows — the rows the data API cannot express, which is why the heading lives in compound mode.
- [DropdownMenuItem](templates/DropdownMenuItemShowcase.md) (`DropdownMenuItemShowcase`): Dropdown menu with custom-rendered items using DropdownMenuItem for icons and descriptions.
- [DropdownMenuItem — Basic](templates/DropdownMenuItemBasic.md) (`DropdownMenuItemBasic`): Dropdown menu items with labels and secondary descriptions. Use DropdownMenuItem to render custom menu entries with consistent styling.
- [Edit form with footer actions](templates/DrawerForm.md) (`DrawerForm`): Compose a Layout with DrawerHeader, the fields in LayoutContent, and Cancel and Save in a pinned LayoutFooter. purpose="form" keeps Escape but ignores scrim clicks, so a stray click outside does not discard edits.
- [EmptyState](templates/EmptyStateShowcase.md) (`EmptyStateShowcase`): A no-results empty state with an icon, descriptive message, and a call-to-action button.
- [EmptyState — Actions](templates/EmptyStateActions.md) (`EmptyStateActions`): Full empty state with icon, message, and action buttons. Use when a search returns no results, a filter clears all items, or a list has been emptied. The buttons give the user a way forward: go back, clear filters, or try a different query.
- [EmptyState — Compact](templates/EmptyStateCompact.md) (`EmptyStateCompact`): Smaller empty state with reduced spacing for constrained areas. Use inside sidebar panels, card widgets, or notification drawers where a full-size empty state would overwhelm the layout.
- [EmptyState — Container](templates/EmptyStateContainer.md) (`EmptyStateContainer`): Empty state wrapped in a Card for first-time setup or onboarding. Use when the user has not created any items yet, like a project list, team roster, or dashboard widget that will fill with data once they take action.
- [Executive Summary Dashboard](templates/dashboard-scorecard.md) (`dashboard-scorecard`): Report-shaped analytics with a prose rail beside the charts: a scorecard of headline numbers with period deltas and status coloring, goal-attainment bars, a trend grid, and a written commentary column that folds beneath the content when narrow.
- [Field](templates/FieldShowcase.md) (`FieldShowcase`): A form field wrapping a text input with a label, description, and validation status.
- [Field — Description](templates/FieldWithDescription.md) (`FieldWithDescription`): Fields with helper text below the label. Use descriptions to explain format requirements, constraints, or what happens with the data, like "At least 8 characters" or "We will send a confirmation link".
- [Field — Required & Optional](templates/FieldRequired.md) (`FieldRequired`): Required and optional field indicators side by side. Use isRequired on fields the user must fill in, and isOptional to clarify which fields can be skipped.
- [Field — Validation States](templates/FieldStatusVariants.md) (`FieldStatusVariants`): All three validation states: error, warning, and success. Use error for invalid input, warning for potential issues like reserved names, and success to confirm valid entries like API keys.
- [FieldLabel](templates/FieldLabelShowcase.md) (`FieldLabelShowcase`): Standalone field labels demonstrating required, optional, tooltip, and icon variations.
- [FieldLabel — Basic](templates/FieldLabelBasic.md) (`FieldLabelBasic`): Standalone labels with required and optional indicators and a helper description. Use when labeling a custom control that does not render its own label.
- [FieldStatus](templates/FieldStatusShowcase.md) (`FieldStatusShowcase`): Field status messages in error, warning, and success states with attached and detached variants.
- [FieldStatus — Basic](templates/FieldStatusBasic.md) (`FieldStatusBasic`): Detached error and success messages for validation feedback. Use below checkboxes, switches, or custom controls where an attached status would overlap.
- [File Explorer](templates/file-explorer.md) (`file-explorer`): Hierarchical browser that drills through nested levels as adjacent columns rather than replacing the list each time, with breadcrumb history, switchable list and grid density, and a metadata pane for the selected node.
- [FileInput](templates/FileInputShowcase.md) (`FileInputShowcase`): 
- [FileInput — Basic](templates/FileInputBasic.md) (`FileInputBasic`): A controlled single-file upload with accepted types, a size limit, and helper text. Use for standard document upload fields in forms.
- [Filterable Table](templates/table-filter.md) (`table-filter`): Flat row collection built around progressive filtering: a token bar that escalates into full query syntax, saved views that persist a filter set, column and grouping options, and a resizable detail pane.
- [Form Wizard](templates/form-wizard.md) (`form-wizard`): Linear multi-step form that moves through one panel at a time, with a horizontal progress track pinned above rather than running down a rail, so every step keeps the full content width for its fields. Only the current step renders, unlike an accordion where each section expands into one long scrolling form. Each advance is validated, and a step left broken stays flagged to jump back to.
- [FormLayout](templates/FormLayoutShowcase.md) (`FormLayoutShowcase`): A vertical form layout with text input fields.
- [FormLayout — Horizontal](templates/FormLayoutHorizontal.md) (`FormLayoutHorizontal`): Two fields side by side for naturally paired inputs like first and last name
- [FormLayout — Mixed Controls](templates/FormLayoutMixedControls.md) (`FormLayoutMixedControls`): Form with different control types: text input, selector, and checkboxes
- [FormLayout — Nested Address Form](templates/FormLayoutNested.md) (`FormLayoutNested`): Address form mixing vertical and horizontal layouts for grouped fields
- [FormLayout — Settings Form](templates/FormLayoutHorizontalLabels.md) (`FormLayoutHorizontalLabels`): Settings form with labels placed beside their inputs
- [Funnel & Cohort Dashboard](templates/dashboard-cohort-funnel.md) (`dashboard-cohort-funnel`): Analytics for sequence and retention questions, pairing two shapes a plain dashboard cannot hold: a staged funnel where each step reads as drop-off against the one before, and a two-axis cohort matrix rendered as a heatmap.
- [Gallery Hero](templates/gallery-hero.md) (`gallery-hero`): Centered stack (headline, short blurb, call-to-action buttons) resolving into a multi-image photo grid rather than one wide full-bleed picture, so the imagery reads as a set.
- [Grid](templates/GridShowcase.md) (`GridShowcase`): 
- [Grid — Card Gallery](templates/GridGalleryExample.md) (`GridGalleryExample`): Card gallery with responsive columns that maintain consistent widths
- [Grid — Column Spanning](templates/GridWithGridSpan.md) (`GridWithGridSpan`): Grid with featured items spanning multiple columns and rows
- [Grid — Dashboard Layout](templates/GridDashboardLayout.md) (`GridDashboardLayout`): Dashboard layout with mixed-size widgets and a full-width summary row
- [Grid — Responsive Auto-Fit](templates/GridResponsiveAutoFit.md) (`GridResponsiveAutoFit`): Responsive grid where cards stretch to fill remaining space
- [GridSpan](templates/GridSpanShowcase.md) (`GridSpanShowcase`): GridSpan lets a grid item span multiple columns or rows within an Grid, enabling masonry-style and asymmetric layouts.
- [GridSpan — Columns](templates/GridSpanColumns.md) (`GridSpanColumns`): Grid items spanning two of three columns. Wrap a grid child in GridSpan to make it occupy multiple columns for asymmetric layouts.
- [Grouped Table](templates/table-grouped.md) (`table-grouped`): Row collection bundled into collapsible sections with per-group counts, so a long list reads as a handful of blocks that expand and collapse. Query filtering and a resizable inspector for the selected row.
- [Heading](templates/HeadingShowcase.md) (`HeadingShowcase`): 
- [Heading — Card Grid](templates/HeadingCardGrid.md) (`HeadingCardGrid`): Responsive card grid with truncated headings and descriptions for uniform layout
- [Heading — Page Hierarchy](templates/HeadingPageLayout.md) (`HeadingPageLayout`): Real-world page layout demonstrating heading levels h1 through h3 with supporting text
- [Heading — Truncation](templates/HeadingTruncation.md) (`HeadingTruncation`): Single-line and multi-line heading truncation with ellipsis for constrained layouts
- [HoverCard](templates/HoverCardShowcase.md) (`HoverCardShowcase`): A hover card that shows a user profile preview when hovering over a trigger button. Starts open for preview.
- [HoverCard — Definition](templates/HoverCardInlineTextHoverCard.md) (`HoverCardInlineTextHoverCard`): Shows a term definition on hover within a paragraph. Use for technical terms, jargon, or concepts that some readers may not know, like a glossary built into the text.
- [HoverCard — Link Preview](templates/HoverCardInteractiveContent.md) (`HoverCardInteractiveContent`): Shows a page summary when hovering a link: title, description, and URL. Use for documentation links, article references, or any URL where a preview helps the user decide whether to click.
- [HoverCard — Profile Preview](templates/HoverCardProfileHoverCard.md) (`HoverCardProfileHoverCard`): Shows a user profile summary on hover with name, role, and bio. Use on usernames, avatars, or mentions to let users preview a profile without navigating away.
- [HStack](templates/HStackShowcase.md) (`HStackShowcase`): Demonstrates HStack arranging items horizontally with different gaps and alignments.
- [HStack — Basic](templates/HStackBasic.md) (`HStackBasic`): Items arranged in a horizontal row with a consistent gap and centered vertical alignment. Use HStack whenever siblings should sit side by side.
- [Icon](templates/IconShowcase.md) (`IconShowcase`): 
- [Icon — Non-Semantic Colors](templates/IconNonSemanticColors.md) (`IconNonSemanticColors`): Non-semantic color palette for icons.
- [Icon — Semantic Colors](templates/IconSemanticColors.md) (`IconSemanticColors`): All semantic icon color variants with labels.
- [Icon — Size Variants](templates/IconSizes.md) (`IconSizes`): All icon sizes from extra-small to large.
- [Icon — Status Indicators](templates/IconStatusIcons.md) (`IconStatusIcons`): Status list using semantic icons for success, warning, error, and info.
- [IconButton](templates/IconButtonShowcase.md) (`IconButtonShowcase`): An icon button with a wrench icon.
- [IconButton — Action Bar](templates/IconButtonActionBar.md) (`IconButtonActionBar`): Row of ghost icon buttons for a compact action toolbar
- [IconButton — Floating](templates/IconButtonFloating.md) (`IconButtonFloating`): A floating action button (FAB). The most common floating-button shape is icon-only. Raised here with `elevation="high"`.
- [IconButton — Loading State](templates/IconButtonLoadingToggle.md) (`IconButtonLoadingToggle`): Icon buttons that show a loading spinner on click for async feedback
- [IconButton — With Tooltips](templates/IconButtonTooltipIconButton.md) (`IconButtonTooltipIconButton`): Icon buttons with tooltips that explain each action on hover
- [IDE](templates/ide.md) (`ide`): Dense multi-pane workspace of resizable, collapsible regions: a hierarchy tree on one flank, tabbed documents in the middle, a docked drawer along the bottom, an inspector opposite. Drag a divider to resize or collapse any of them.
- [Inbox Table](templates/table-inbox.md) (`table-inbox`): Two-pane message queue: the table indexes a reading pane rather than being the destination, with a divider you drag to resize. Rows stack when the table narrows, not the window; threads read as collapsible messages; replying opens a composer that leaves the list live.
- [Incident Console](templates/incident-console.md) (`incident-console`): Dense row queue with an inspector: severity-coded rows grouped by status, a saved-search filter bar, a segmented status control, and a resizable detail pane for the selected row. Rows, not cards, sized for scanning volume.
- [InfoTip](templates/InfoTipShowcase.md) (`InfoTipShowcase`): 
- [InfoTip — Metric Definitions](templates/InfoTipMetricDefinitions.md) (`InfoTipMetricDefinitions`): A row of metrics, each label followed by an InfoTip that defines how the value is counted.
- [InfoTip — Permission Notes](templates/InfoTipPermissionNotes.md) (`InfoTipPermissionNotes`): Read-only settings whose labels carry an InfoTip that says who can change each value.
- [Inline Wizard](templates/form-wizard-inline.md) (`form-wizard-inline`): Accordion wizard stacking every step in one column: the active step expands in place while finished ones collapse to a single line carrying their result and a way back in. Steps that run themselves expand into a nested stepper that ticks check by check and halts the column where one fails. Best when later steps depend on what earlier ones decided.
- [InputGroup](templates/InputGroupShowcase.md) (`InputGroupShowcase`): 
- [InputGroup — Basic](templates/InputGroupBasic.md) (`InputGroupBasic`): A currency field with static prefix and suffix addons around a TextInput. Use InputGroupText to clarify units or input format.
- [InternationalizationProvider — Overrides](templates/InternationalizationProvider02Overrides.md) (`InternationalizationProvider02Overrides`): Override a small number of Astryx strings without providing a full locale catalog.
- [InternationalizationProvider — RTL Direction](templates/InternationalizationProvider03RtlDirection.md) (`InternationalizationProvider03RtlDirection`): Toggle text direction with the `dir` prop and watch Astryx components mirror. Pagination flips its prev/next chevrons under RTL. The `dir` prop is passed to both `InternationalizationProvider` (so Astryx components pick it up) and the `VStack` (so the DOM subtree mirrors); both channels stay in sync with no extra wrapper.
- [InternationalizationProvider — Shipped Locale](templates/InternationalizationProvider01ShippedLocale.md) (`InternationalizationProvider01ShippedLocale`): Load a locale catalog shipped by Astryx and re-render InternationalizationProvider with a new locale to update Astryx strings live.
- [Item](templates/ItemShowcase.md) (`ItemShowcase`): 
- [Item — Basic](templates/ItemBasicItem.md) (`ItemBasicItem`): A basic item with a label, supporting description, and end-aligned timestamp. Use this for simple rows that need consistent text alignment and spacing.
- [Item — Document Tabs](templates/ItemDocumentTabs.md) (`ItemDocumentTabs`): Single-row, horizontally scrollable document switcher with compact selected rows, leading file icons, instant reveal-on-hover close actions with reserved geometry, stable separators, and an add control outside the scroll area. Use for editor tabs, workspace tabs, open documents, files, canvases, or panels.
- [Item — Metadata](templates/ItemWithMetadata.md) (`ItemWithMetadata`): Status rows with an icon, a title, a short description, and end-aligned metadata such as a timestamp or a status badge, here build, memory, and sync events. Use the endContent slot for counts, status, timestamps, and other secondary row information.
- [Item — Start Content](templates/ItemWithMedia.md) (`ItemWithMedia`): Items with leading avatars and icons in the startContent slot. Keep start content small so the row stays compact and easy to scan.
- [Kanban Board](templates/kanban-board.md) (`kanban-board`): Horizontal lanes of draggable cards where the column itself is the status, so drag and drop between lanes is the state change. Fixed columns, variable-height cards.
- [Kbd](templates/KbdShowcase.md) (`KbdShowcase`): 
- [Kbd — Inline Instructions](templates/KbdInlineInstructions.md) (`KbdInlineInstructions`): Keyboard shortcuts rendered inline within instructional text
- [Kbd — Menu Shortcuts](templates/KbdMenuShortcuts.md) (`KbdMenuShortcuts`): Menu-style list pairing action labels with their keyboard shortcuts
- [Kbd — Modifier Combinations](templates/KbdModifierCombos.md) (`KbdModifierCombos`): Modifier combinations and special keys rendered as shortcut badges
- [Layout](templates/LayoutShowcase.md) (`LayoutShowcase`): 
- [Layout — Basic Card](templates/LayoutBasicCardLayout.md) (`LayoutBasicCardLayout`): A card layout with header, scrollable content area, and footer with action buttons.
- [Layout — Content Only](templates/LayoutContentOnlyLayout.md) (`LayoutContentOnlyLayout`): A minimal layout with just a content area inside a card, without header or footer.
- [Layout — Content Width](templates/LayoutContentWidth.md) (`LayoutContentWidth`): A layout using contentWidth to constrain and center content while keeping dividers full-bleed.
- [Layout — Dual Panel](templates/LayoutDualPanelLayout.md) (`LayoutDualPanelLayout`): A file browser style layout with start panel for folders, main content for files, and end panel for details.
- [Layout — Full Bleed Content](templates/LayoutFullBleedContent.md) (`LayoutFullBleedContent`): A layout where content extends edge-to-edge with zero padding, ideal for tables or images.
- [Layout — Sidebar Navigation](templates/LayoutSidebarLayout.md) (`LayoutSidebarLayout`): A settings page layout with a navigation sidebar panel, content area, header, and footer.
- [LayoutContent](templates/LayoutContentShowcase.md) (`LayoutContentShowcase`): LayoutContent is the scrollable main content area within a Layout, providing automatic padding and scroll containment between the header and footer.
- [LayoutContent — Basic](templates/LayoutContentBasic.md) (`LayoutContentBasic`): A scrollable main content area below a fixed header. Use LayoutContent inside Layout to get automatic padding and scroll containment for the primary content.
- [LayoutFooter](templates/LayoutFooterShowcase.md) (`LayoutFooterShowcase`): LayoutFooter is a fixed footer slot within a Layout, pinned to the bottom for persistent actions like form buttons or navigation.
- [LayoutFooter — Actions](templates/LayoutFooterActions.md) (`LayoutFooterActions`): A fixed footer with end-aligned action buttons below scrollable content. Use LayoutFooter inside Layout for persistent actions like Save and Cancel.
- [LayoutHeader](templates/LayoutHeaderShowcase.md) (`LayoutHeaderShowcase`): LayoutHeader is a fixed header slot within a Layout, pinned to the top for titles, navigation, and action buttons.
- [LayoutHeader — With Actions](templates/LayoutHeaderWithActions.md) (`LayoutHeaderWithActions`): A fixed page header with a title and a primary action, above scrollable content. Use LayoutHeader inside Layout for persistent page-level headers.
- [LayoutPanel](templates/LayoutPanelShowcase.md) (`LayoutPanelShowcase`): LayoutPanel is a sidebar slot within a Layout, used for navigation, detail views, or secondary content alongside the main content area.
- [LayoutPanel — Navigation](templates/LayoutPanelNavigation.md) (`LayoutPanelNavigation`): A fixed-width side panel holding a navigation list next to the main content. Use LayoutPanel in the start or end slot of Layout for sidebars.
- [Lightbox](templates/LightboxShowcase.md) (`LightboxShowcase`): A fullscreen image viewer with caption.
- [Lightbox — Gallery](templates/LightboxGallery.md) (`LightboxGallery`): A thumbnail grid that opens a fullscreen gallery. Clicking any thumbnail opens the lightbox at that index. Prev/next navigation lets users browse all images without closing.
- [Lightbox — Video](templates/LightboxVideo.md) (`LightboxVideo`): Opens a video in the lightbox. Native browser controls are available. Zoom and pan are disabled for video items.
- [Lightbox — Zoom](templates/LightboxZoom.md) (`LightboxZoom`): A lightbox with zoom and pan enabled. Double-click the image to zoom in; drag to pan around. Double-click again or use the close button to exit.
- [Link](templates/LinkShowcase.md) (`LinkShowcase`): A standalone link.
- [Link — External Links](templates/LinkExternalLinks.md) (`LinkExternalLinks`): A vertical list of external links that open in a new tab with an indicator icon.
- [Link — Inline Text](templates/LinkInlineLink.md) (`LinkInlineLink`): A link embedded within a paragraph of body text.
- [Link — With Tooltips](templates/LinksWithTooltips.md) (`LinksWithTooltips`): Horizontal row of standalone links with descriptive hover tooltips.
- [Link Provider — Custom Link Component](templates/LinkProviderCustomLink.md) (`LinkProviderCustomLink`): Routes every Astryx link through a custom component that intercepts the click, the hook frameworks like Next.js use for client-side navigation. Click the link to see the custom handler fire instead of a full-page load.
- [List](templates/ListShowcase.md) (`ListShowcase`): 
- [List — Basic](templates/ListBasicList.md) (`ListBasicList`): Simple list with labels and descriptions for settings-style layouts.
- [List — Bulleted Features](templates/ListBulletedFeatures.md) (`ListBulletedFeatures`): Bulleted list of feature highlights using disc markers.
- [List — Message List](templates/ListMessageList.md) (`ListMessageList`): Chat-style message list with avatars, preview text, and unread badges.
- [List — Ordered Steps](templates/ListOrderedSteps.md) (`ListOrderedSteps`): Numbered step-by-step instructions using decimal list markers.
- [List Item — Basic](templates/ListItemBasicItem.md) (`ListItemBasicItem`): Basic list items with labels and descriptions. Use this structure for settings, navigation summaries, and other simple collections.
- [List Item — Media](templates/ListItemWithMedia.md) (`ListItemWithMedia`): List items with leading avatars and icons. Use startContent for compact visual identifiers that help users scan the collection.
- [List Item — Metadata](templates/ListItemWithMetadata.md) (`ListItemWithMetadata`): List items with end-aligned metadata. Use endContent for badges, counts, timestamps, and compact status details.
- [ListItem](templates/ListItemShowcase.md) (`ListItemShowcase`): List items with icons, descriptions, and end content slots demonstrating the full ListItem API.
- [Login Card](templates/login-card.md) (`login-card`): Credential form inside an elevated centered card, third-party provider buttons separated from the fields by a divider, secondary sign-up and legal links beneath.
- [Login Split](templates/login-split.md) (`login-split`): Credential form filling one half of a two-pane split, full-bleed media holding the other. Same fields as the card variant, but the layout carries brand imagery.
- [Login SSO](templates/login-sso.md) (`login-sso`): Progressive credential flow that branches on input: the email domain resolves an identity provider and redirects, with a password path as fallback. Two-stage rather than one form.
- [Markdown](templates/MarkdownShowcase.md) (`MarkdownShowcase`): Rich markdown content with headings, lists, and formatting.
- [Markdown — Cited Content](templates/MarkdownCitedContent.md) (`MarkdownCitedContent`): Markdown with citation chips linked to external sources
- [Markdown — Compact AI Response](templates/MarkdownCompactAIResponse.md) (`MarkdownCompactAIResponse`): Compact markdown styled for AI responses with shifted heading levels
- [Markdown — Data Table](templates/MarkdownDataTable.md) (`MarkdownDataTable`): Comparison table rendered from a markdown string
- [Markdown — Rich Content](templates/MarkdownRichContent.md) (`MarkdownRichContent`): Markdown with headings, lists, code blocks, tables, blockquotes, and task lists
- [MediaTheme — Image Overlay](templates/MediaThemeImageOverlay.md) (`MediaThemeImageOverlay`): A common image card pattern: place text and actions over a dark gradient and wrap the overlay content in MediaTheme mode="dark".
- [MediaTheme — Light Scrim](templates/MediaThemeLightScrim.md) (`MediaThemeLightScrim`): A light scrim over an image. Use MediaTheme mode="light" so text and ghost buttons use dark-on-light tokens.
- [MediaTheme — Media Overlay](templates/MediaThemeShowcase.md) (`MediaThemeShowcase`): A compact media overlay showing MediaTheme adapting text, icons, badges, and button variants over an image-backed dark surface.
- [Messaging Shell](templates/messaging-shell.md) (`messaging-shell`): Four-column nested navigation narrowing left to right (team workspace, channel list, message stream, thread panel) where each column scopes the next. Dense rows, zero cards.
- [MetadataList](templates/MetadataListShowcase.md) (`MetadataListShowcase`): 
- [MetadataList — Basic](templates/MetadataListBasicMetadata.md) (`MetadataListBasicMetadata`): Single-column key-value metadata list.
- [MetadataList — Collapsible](templates/MetadataListCollapsibleMetadata.md) (`MetadataListCollapsibleMetadata`): Metadata list with a show-more toggle after a set number of items.
- [MetadataList — Horizontal](templates/MetadataListHorizontalMetadata.md) (`MetadataListHorizontalMetadata`): Horizontal metadata items for compact inline display.
- [MetadataList — Multi-Column](templates/MetadataListMultiColumnMetadata.md) (`MetadataListMultiColumnMetadata`): Multi-column metadata grid with token tags.
- [MetadataListItem](templates/MetadataListItemShowcase.md) (`MetadataListItemShowcase`): Metadata list items displaying labeled values in various formats including text, badges, and links.
- [MetadataListItem — Basic](templates/MetadataListItemBasic.md) (`MetadataListItemBasic`): A titled section of label and value rows for one record, here a deployment's environment, health status badge, version, and last deploy date. Values take plain text or a component such as a Badge.
- [Mixed Gallery](templates/mixed-gallery.md) (`mixed-gallery`): Masonry grid of variable-height tiles that pack against each other instead of cropping to a shared ratio, captioned per tile. Irregular rhythm, unlike the uniform gallery.
- [MobileNav](templates/MobileNavShowcase.md) (`MobileNavShowcase`): 
- [MobileNav — Basic Drawer](templates/MobileNavBasicMobileNav.md) (`MobileNavBasicMobileNav`): Mobile navigation drawer with sectioned nav items triggered by a menu button
- [MobileNav — End Side Drawer](templates/MobileNavEndSideMobileNav.md) (`MobileNavEndSideMobileNav`): Navigation drawer that slides in from the right side of the screen
- [MobileNav — Without Title](templates/MobileNavWithoutTitleMobileNav.md) (`MobileNavWithoutTitleMobileNav`): Mobile navigation drawer without a title header
- [MobileNavToggle](templates/MobileNavToggleShowcase.md) (`MobileNavToggleShowcase`): Demonstrates MobileNavToggle as a standalone hamburger button for opening the mobile navigation drawer.
- [MobileNavToggle — Basic](templates/MobileNavToggleBasic.md) (`MobileNavToggleBasic`): A nav toggle with a custom icon and accessible label instead of the default hamburger. It opens a MobileNav drawer via the AppShell mobile context, which AppShell provides automatically.
- [Modal or non-modal (hasScrim)](templates/DrawerScrim.md) (`DrawerScrim`): The default modal drawer dims the page, traps focus, and closes on a scrim click. With hasScrim={false}, the drawer has no scrim or focus trap and leaves the page interactive.
- [MoreMenu](templates/MoreMenuShowcase.md) (`MoreMenuShowcase`): A basic three-dot menu with simple action items.
- [MoreMenu — Bottom Sheet](templates/MoreMenuBottomSheet.md) (`MoreMenuBottomSheet`): A visible overflow trigger that opens actions in a BottomSheet. Use this presentation for short action sets on compact touch surfaces.
- [MoreMenu — Default](templates/MoreMenuDefaultMoreMenu.md) (`MoreMenuDefaultMoreMenu`): Basic three-dot overflow menu with simple text-only action items.
- [MoreMenu — With Dividers](templates/MoreMenuWithDividers.md) (`MoreMenuWithDividers`): A three-dot menu with a divider separating destructive actions from safe ones.
- [MoreMenu — With Sections](templates/MoreMenuWithSections.md) (`MoreMenuWithSections`): A three-dot menu with actions organized into labeled groups.
- [MultiSelector](templates/MultiSelectorShowcase.md) (`MultiSelectorShowcase`): 
- [MultiSelector — Bottom Sheet](templates/MultiSelectorBottomSheet.md) (`MultiSelectorBottomSheet`): Keeps a multi-selection list open in a bottom sheet while choices are toggled.
- [MultiSelector — Column Visibility](templates/MultiSelectorColumnVisibilitySelector.md) (`MultiSelectorColumnVisibilitySelector`): Column visibility toggle with hidden label, search, select-all, and selection count.
- [MultiSelector — Form Composition](templates/MultiSelectorForm.md) (`MultiSelectorForm`): Two multi-selectors in a form with required/optional states.
- [MultiSelector — Ghost Toolbar](templates/MultiSelectorGhostToolbar.md) (`MultiSelectorGhostToolbar`): Borderless MultiSelector variant composed with ghost buttons in a toolbar.
- [MultiSelector — Searchable](templates/MultiSelectorSearchableMultiSelector.md) (`MultiSelectorSearchableMultiSelector`): Multi-select with search filtering and select-all.
- [MultiSelector — Sectioned Permissions](templates/MultiSelectorSectionedMultiSelector.md) (`MultiSelectorSectionedMultiSelector`): Multi-select with options grouped into labeled sections.
- [NavHeadingMenu](templates/NavHeadingMenuShowcase.md) (`NavHeadingMenuShowcase`): NavHeadingMenu passed as the menu prop of SideNavHeading, letting the heading act as a product switcher popover trigger.
- [NavIcon](templates/NavIconShowcase.md) (`NavIconShowcase`): Circular icon containers for navigation headers with accent backgrounds.
- [NavIcon — Basic](templates/NavIconBasic.md) (`NavIconBasic`): Circular icon containers wrapping semantic icons. Use as logos or accent icons in navigation headers such as TopNavHeading.
- [NumberInput](templates/NumberInputShowcase.md) (`NumberInputShowcase`): A number input for quantity entry.
- [NumberInput — Clearable](templates/NumberInputClearableNumberInput.md) (`NumberInputClearableNumberInput`): Number input with a clear button, unit suffix, and min/max constraint
- [NumberInput — Range Constrained](templates/NumberInputRangeNumberInput.md) (`NumberInputRangeNumberInput`): Number input with min/max boundaries and a helper description
- [NumberInput — Status Variants](templates/NumberInputStatuses.md) (`NumberInputStatuses`): Number inputs showing error, warning, and success validation states
- [NumberInput — With Units](templates/NumberInputWithUnits.md) (`NumberInputWithUnits`): Number input with a percentage unit suffix and valid range
- [Order Detail](templates/detail-page.md) (`detail-page`): Single-record detail in two columns: a summary header with status and actions, a repeating line-item list, a totals block that sums it, and a chronological activity timeline in the rail. The shape for any record holding children plus a history: a customer order with shipping, an invoice, a transaction, or a job.
- [Outline](templates/OutlineShowcase.md) (`OutlineShowcase`): A document outline with the active section highlighted by the sliding indicator track.
- [Outline — Controlled](templates/OutlineControlled.md) (`OutlineControlled`): Drive the active section yourself with activeId and onActiveIdChange. Providing activeId disables the built-in scroll-spy so your own logic owns the highlight.
- [Outline — Deep Nesting](templates/OutlineDeepNesting.md) (`OutlineDeepNesting`): Heading levels 1 through 4 map to progressively deeper indentation, so a long document with sub-sections stays scannable.
- [Outline — Density](templates/OutlineDensity.md) (`OutlineDensity`): Two density variants control item padding. Use compact for dense sidebars and default for standard documentation layouts. The sliding indicator automatically matches each item height.
- [OverflowList](templates/OverflowListShowcase.md) (`OverflowListShowcase`): A list of buttons that collapses overflowing items into a +N indicator.
- [OverflowList — Badge Tags](templates/OverflowListOverflowBadges.md) (`OverflowListOverflowBadges`): Resizable row of badges that collapses into a count badge on overflow
- [OverflowList — Capped Toolbar](templates/OverflowListCappedToolbar.md) (`OverflowListCappedToolbar`): maxVisibleItems caps the row at three actions even when more would fit; the rest move to a dropdown
- [OverflowList — Collapse From Start](templates/OverflowListCollapseFromStartList.md) (`OverflowListCollapseFromStartList`): Overflow list that hides items from the start, keeping the latest visible
- [OverflowList — Dropdown Actions](templates/OverflowListOverflowDropdownActions.md) (`OverflowListOverflowDropdownActions`): Action toolbar that collapses overflow buttons into a dropdown menu
- [OverflowList — Multi-row Tags](templates/OverflowListMultiRowTags.md) (`OverflowListMultiRowTags`): Tags wrap onto up to two rows with maxRows, then collapse the rest into a count badge
- [Overlay](templates/OverlayShowcase.md) (`OverlayShowcase`): A media card with an always-visible scrim and centered action content.
- [Overlay — Bottom Strip](templates/OverlayBottomStrip.md) (`OverlayBottomStrip`): Places compact supporting content in a bottom scrim strip without covering the entire image.
- [Overlay — Hover Reveal](templates/OverlayHoverReveal.md) (`OverlayHoverReveal`): Reveals an overlay action on hover or keyboard focus. Use when actions should stay visually quiet until the media receives attention.
- [Page Editor](templates/editor.md) (`editor`): Three-pane authoring workspace: a source palette on one flank, a live canvas in the middle, and an inspector that retargets to whatever is selected. Drag and drop to reorder, edit to see it render immediately.
- [Pagination — Dots Carousel](templates/PaginationDotsCarousel.md) (`PaginationDotsCarousel`): A review carousel using dot pagination to step through testimonial cards. Use the dots variant for carousels, galleries, and any paged content where the total is small and visible position matters more than a page number.
- [Pagination — Page Size Selector](templates/PaginationPageSize.md) (`PaginationPageSize`): A transactions table with pagination and a page size dropdown at the bottom. Shows how pagination works as a footer below real content, with adjustable rows per page.
- [Pagination — Variants](templates/PaginationVariants.md) (`PaginationVariants`): All four display variants stacked: dots, compact, count, and pages. A quick visual reference for choosing the right variant.
- [Pagination — With Table](templates/PaginationWithTable.md) (`PaginationWithTable`): Pagination below a data table with client-side page slicing. Use the count variant with small size for dense data views where users need to see item ranges.
- [Popover](templates/PopoverShowcase.md) (`PopoverShowcase`): 
- [Popover — Bottom Sheet Alternative](templates/PopoverBottomSheetAlternative.md) (`PopoverBottomSheetAlternative`): Opt-in BottomSheet alternative for compact touch surfaces where actions should use a modal presentation anchored to the bottom edge.
- [Popover — Confirm Action](templates/PopoverConfirmAction.md) (`PopoverConfirmAction`): Inline confirmation popover for destructive actions with delete and cancel buttons.
- [Popover — Filter Panel](templates/PopoverFilterPanel.md) (`PopoverFilterPanel`): Popover with checkbox filters and apply/reset actions.
- [Popover — Keyboard Shortcuts](templates/PopoverKeyboardShortcuts.md) (`PopoverKeyboardShortcuts`): Popover displaying a list of keyboard shortcuts with key and description pairs.
- [Popover — Settings Panel](templates/PopoverSettingsPanel.md) (`PopoverSettingsPanel`): Popover with toggle switches for managing user preferences like notifications, dark mode, and sounds.
- [Portfolio Dashboard](templates/dashboard-composition.md) (`dashboard-composition`): Analytics for a value-over-time question: balance and change tiles above a stacked area chart of composition through time, closing on a ranked table of the largest contributors.
- [PowerSearch](templates/PowerSearchShowcase.md) (`PowerSearchShowcase`): Token-based filter bar with enum and text fields, pre-populated with sample filters.
- [PowerSearch — Content Search](templates/PowerSearchContentSearch.md) (`PowerSearchContentSearch`): Power search with contentSearchFieldKey so free-text input maps to a title field automatically.
- [PowerSearch — Full Featured](templates/PowerSearchFullFeatured.md) (`PowerSearchFullFeatured`): Power search with multiple field types: enum, multi-select, entity, and text filters.
- [PowerSearch — Preset Filters](templates/PowerSearchPresetFilters.md) (`PowerSearchPresetFilters`): Power search initialized with pre-set filter tokens for status and priority.
- [PowerSearch — Search with Table](templates/PowerSearchSearchWithTable.md) (`PowerSearchSearchWithTable`): Composition of PowerSearch with Table using usePowerSearchConfig to auto-generate config and filter data.
- [Product Detail](templates/product-detail.md) (`product-detail`): Single-item detail pairing a media gallery with a selection column: variant swatches, a quantity stepper, primary and secondary commit actions, and collapsible specification sections below.
- [Product Gallery](templates/product-gallery.md) (`product-gallery`): Uniform card grid where every tile carries media, title, supporting line, and a price. Browse-to-select only, with no filtering and no detail surface.
- [ProgressBar](templates/ProgressBarShowcase.md) (`ProgressBarShowcase`): A progress bar filled to 60%.
- [ProgressBar — Custom Format](templates/ProgressBarCustomFormat.md) (`ProgressBarCustomFormat`): Progress bar with a custom value label showing disk usage in GB.
- [ProgressBar — Indeterminate](templates/ProgressBarIndeterminate.md) (`ProgressBarIndeterminate`): Indeterminate progress bar for operations with unknown duration.
- [ProgressBar — Semantic Variants](templates/ProgressBarSemanticVariants.md) (`ProgressBarSemanticVariants`): All semantic color variants stacked vertically.
- [ProgressBar — With Value Label](templates/ProgressBarWithValueLabel.md) (`ProgressBarWithValueLabel`): Progress bar with its current percentage displayed.
- [Project Status Dashboard](templates/dashboard-progress.md) (`dashboard-progress`): Status analytics mixing progress and time-axis shapes: a completion donut, a horizontal timeline of dated bars against a today marker, a per-owner table with progress and status, an at-risk list, and a burndown.
- [RadioList](templates/RadioListShowcase.md) (`RadioListShowcase`): 
- [RadioList — Horizontal Layout](templates/RadioListHorizontalLayout.md) (`RadioListHorizontalLayout`): Radio list with horizontal orientation for compact selections.
- [RadioList — Pricing Tier](templates/RadioListPricingTier.md) (`RadioListPricingTier`): Radio list with pricing info in end content for plan selection.
- [RadioList — With Descriptions](templates/RadioListWithDescriptions.md) (`RadioListWithDescriptions`): Radio list with descriptions on the group and each item.
- [RadioList — With Validation](templates/RadioListWithValidation.md) (`RadioListWithValidation`): Required radio list with an error message when nothing is selected.
- [RadioListItem](templates/RadioListItemShowcase.md) (`RadioListItemShowcase`): Radio list items with labels, descriptions, and different states including disabled.
- [RadioListItem — Basic](templates/RadioListItemBasic.md) (`RadioListItemBasic`): Radio items with labels and descriptions inside a controlled RadioList. Use for single-choice option groups like shipping methods.
- [Resizable](templates/ResizableShowcase.md) (`ResizableShowcase`): Horizontal resizable split with a draggable handle between two panels.
- [Resizable — Collapsible with snap points](templates/ResizableSidebar.md) (`ResizableSidebar`): A collapsible sidebar with snap points, driven by useResizable. Dragging snaps to preset widths, dragging past the minimum collapses the panel, and the expand method restores it programmatically.
- [ScrollableArea](templates/ScrollableAreaShowcase.md) (`ScrollableAreaShowcase`): A fixed-height file panel that scrolls on the block axis; the heading sits inside the viewport, so it scrolls away with the content.
- [ScrollableArea — Inline Rail](templates/ScrollableAreaInlineRail.md) (`ScrollableAreaInlineRail`): axis="inline" scrolls the same cards sideways; isFullBleed lets the rail run to the panel edges while the content padding keeps the first card aligned with the heading.
- [ScrollableArea — Overscroll](templates/ScrollableAreaOverscrollChaining.md) (`ScrollableAreaOverscrollChaining`): The same section, two edge policies: the default overscroll="allow" hands a gesture that reaches the end to the panel behind it, while overscroll="contain" stops it at the section edge.
- [ScrollableArea — Sticky Passthrough](templates/ScrollableAreaStickyPassthrough.md) (`ScrollableAreaStickyPassthrough`): A section whose content fits clips instead of scrolling, so its sticky label passes outward and pins to the panel edge. The next section sets stickyContainment="always" and keeps its label in its own box.
- [ScrollableArea — Sticky Section Labels](templates/ScrollableAreaStickyGroupHeaders.md) (`ScrollableAreaStickyGroupHeaders`): A scrollable viewport is the containing block for position: sticky, so section labels pin to the top edge of the list instead of the page.
- [ScrollableArea — Two-Axis Board](templates/ScrollableAreaTwoAxisBoard.md) (`ScrollableAreaTwoAxisBoard`): axis="both" gives the content box max-content inline sizing, so a board wider and taller than its panel scrolls on both axes from one viewport.
- [Searchable Table](templates/table-page.md) (`table-page`): Flat table of uniform rows under a block of record-level facts, narrowed three ways at once — a full-text search box, a scope toggle, and per-column popovers — with sortable and filterable columns, per-row hover detail, and totals derived from the visible rows that flag themselves as partial while a filter is on. The shape for one homogeneous list, not nested rows or groups with their own columns.
- [Section — Default with Wash](templates/SectionWashHighlight.md) (`SectionWashHighlight`): A default section stacked with a full-width muted section. Shows how muted draws attention to a specific region like an upgrade prompt or banner.
- [Section — Variants](templates/SectionVariants.md) (`SectionVariants`): All three background variants stacked: section (default surface), muted, and transparent. A quick visual reference for choosing the right variant.
- [Section — With Dividers](templates/SectionWithDividers.md) (`SectionWithDividers`): Adjacent sections separated by bottom dividers, like a settings page. Use dividers when stacking same-variant sections that need visual separation without a background change.
- [SegmentedControl](templates/SegmentedControlShowcase.md) (`SegmentedControlShowcase`): 
- [SegmentedControl — Disabled Item](templates/SegmentedControlDisabledItem.md) (`SegmentedControlDisabledItem`): Segmented control with an individually disabled option for unavailable choices.
- [SegmentedControl — Fill Layout](templates/SegmentedControlFillLayout.md) (`SegmentedControlFillLayout`): Segmented control that stretches segments equally to fill the available width, useful for fixed-width containers.
- [SegmentedControl — Icon Only](templates/SegmentedControlIconOnly.md) (`SegmentedControlIconOnly`): Compact segmented control with hidden labels, showing only icons for space-constrained layouts.
